content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-153. - Authorization.
content.summary:
The city hereby authorizes the city clerk to accept applications for tastings to be
               conducted by retail liquor store, fermented malt beverage and wine retailer, and liquor-licensed
               drugstore licensees in accordance with this section and pursuant to C.R.S. § 44-3-301(10)…

faqs.a:
The city hereby authorizes the city clerk to accept applications for tastings to be
               conducted by retail liquor store, fermented malt beverage and wine retailer, and liquor-licensed
               drugstore licensees in accordance with this section and pursuant to C.R.S. § 44-3-301(10)(a).
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018; Ord. No.
4839
, § 1, 3-20-2023)
